items.title: Kirloskar Industries Q2 profit rises 5% to Rs 105 crore
items.description: Kirloskar Industries (KIL) achieved a consolidated profit after tax of ₹105 crore for the quarter ending September 30, reflecting a 5% increase from ₹100.1 crore in the previous year’s corresponding quarter. The overall income surged to ₹2,097.7 crore, up from ₹1,790.1 crore, highlighting robust operational performance. Kirloskar Ferrous Industries, a key subsidiary, showcased strong demand, while Avante Spaces progresses steadily in the real estate market.

items.title: NSE looks beyond transaction fees to drive growth
items.description: NSE reported a sequential decline in revenue and profit in the September quarter from previous results. The drop resulted from a 16% fall in transaction charges and reduced trading activity. NSE plans to enhance market activity through amendments to its Closing Auction Session framework expected in December. Additionally, the exchange is diversifying its offerings into commodity derivatives and digital gold products.
